name: read_page
description: Read the full body of a single wiki document. Returns `{path, title, body, agents}`. The `agents` list shows other users / named agents currently reading or writing the same doc — use it to coordinate (e.g. avoid clobbering an in-flight edit). Errors if the path doesn't exist or isn't a `.md` file. Calling `read_page` on a path is the only way to satisfy the read-before-write requirement enforced by `edit_doc` / `multi_edit` / `write_doc` for existing files.

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file (e.g. `auth/passwords.md`). Must end in `.md`.
